apps.title: FractioCraft Visualizer
apps.tagline: Dynamic visual arithmetic, area models, and fraction partitioning for spatial comprehension.
apps.description: An interactive mathematical laboratory that makes abstract fraction relationships tangible through sliceable shapes, balance scales, and number lines.
apps.longDescription: FractioCraft was built to eliminate fraction anxiety in upper-elementary and middle school students. Through multi-representational learning, students manipulate geometric pies, linear tape diagrams, and liquid measuring beakers simultaneously. Real-time algebraic feedback links intuitive physical actions directly to symbolic fraction operations.
keyHighlights: Fraction equivalence balance scale with real-time tipping physics
learningObjectives: Deconstruct mixed numbers into unit fractions and visual equivalents
Discover common denominators through geometric cross-partitioning
Develop spatial intuition for fraction multiplication and division

apps.title: Elementa: Periodic Explorer
apps.tagline: Interactive atomic orbitals, thermal phase transitions, and periodic trends visualizer.
apps.description: Explore the chemical elements beyond flat tables with live electron orbitals, temperature-controlled states of matter, and elemental properties.
apps.longDescription: Elementa transforms chemical education by providing an intuitive, multi-dimensional gateway to the periodic table of elements. Students can drag dynamic temperature sliders from absolute zero to 6,000 Kelvin to watch phase transitions in real time, inspect electron shell orbital occupancies, and visualize trends like electronegativity and atomic radius.
keyHighlights: Interactive Kelvin temperature slider with phase changes
Electron orbital modeler with spin and energy levels
High-contrast mode and accessible spectral descriptions
learningObjectives: Understand periodic trends across periods, groups, and chemical families
Model valence electron configurations and ionic formation
Observe physical states of matter across extreme temperature shifts

apps.title: Pendulum & Gravity Lab
apps.tagline: Precision harmonic motion, gravity field simulations, and energy conservation graphs.
apps.description: A physics simulation engine illustrating single, double, and chaotic pendulums under selectable gravitational fields (Earth, Moon, Jupiter, Zero-G).
apps.longDescription: Engineered for physics curricula, this application lets students experiment with bob mass, string length, damping air resistance, and planetary gravitational constants. Real-time kinetic versus potential energy graphs update on every frame, demonstrating mechanical energy conservation and phase space dynamics.
keyHighlights: Planetary gravity presets (Earth, Moon, Jupiter, Zero-G, Custom)
Coupled double pendulum chaos visualizer with trajectory tracer
Real-time kinetic and potential energy conservation telemetry
learningObjectives: Calculate period formulas T = 2π√(L/g) and verify experimentally
Analyze energy conversions between kinetic, potential, and thermal dissipation
Observe chaotic bifurcations in coupled pendulums

apps.title: AlgoScript Code Blocks
apps.tagline: Dual visual-block to Python programming environment with step-by-step memory stack execution.
apps.description: A block-based to text coding bridge for introductory computer science students that visualizes call stacks, variable states, and loops in real-time.
apps.longDescription: AlgoScript demystifies programming logic by displaying snap-together visual blocks side-by-side with clean, standard Python syntax. A built-in virtual runtime steps through code line-by-line while dynamically highlighting active memory registers, arrays, and control flow branching.
keyHighlights: Step-by-step visual execution debugger with variable inspector
learningObjectives: Master loops, conditionals, and boolean logic constructs
Trace variable state transformations across program lifecycles
Transition smoothly from visual blocks to text-based syntax
